messages:
maria: Quick UX check — noticed some weird drag ghosting in the routing editor when you reorder compact rule cards. Also the preview sim heatmap feels clipped on small widths. Can we do a quick pass?
charlie: Agree. On compact cards the ghost overlaps the drop target by ~6px, looks like a z-index/translate bug. Screenshot in thread. :eyes:
anya: I can repro — happens when list is in condensed mode and card uses transform for smooth move. Might be the placeholder height calc.
kevin: If transform is used for animation our hit testing might still use original layout. We could toggle pointer-events or switch to CSS top/left for the dragged element. Tradeoffs: smoother vs layout jank.
charlie: For the visual we prefer the ghost to be semi-transparent and not cover the target affordance. Suggest: ghost opacity 0.7 + a thin dashed placeholder outline showing exact drop anchor.
maria: Nice. Also copy nit in sim preview: when there are zero matches it currently says `No matching routes found` — product requested friendlier language. Proposed: `No active routing rules match this input yet.` Slightly clearer about intent.
lydia: A11y: screenreader currently announces "dragging" but doesn't announce the new position after drop. We need an aria-live region update like: ```aria-live="polite" id="route-order-announcer">Rule X moved to position 2``` Also ensure placeholder is focusable when keyboard-reordering.
anya: Will add aria-live update on successful reorder and add keyboard handle focus state. For drag ghost fix I can try switching to absolute positioning during drag to get predictable hit boxes.
kevin: I'll add a short validation toast anchor change — to avoid overlaying the sim controls. Anchor toast to the rules panel not the top nav. Small patch.
charlie: Regarding heatmap clipping: it's because our preview canvas uses css `overflow:hidden` at narrow widths. Proposal: allow vertical scroll inside preview pane and collapse legend under a chevron on <720px.
maria: Timeline: can we get a small patch for copy + toast + ghost fix for next sprint (sprint starts Monday)? Lydia will run SR tests once patches land.
lydia: I'll run a quick screenreader pass once PRs are merged. Also will post failing cases in this thread so QA can add them.
anya: I'll open a PR for the ghost/keyboard updates today, link here when ready.
kevin: I'll do the toast/anchor + move the sim legend collapse in a separate PR.
ux-bot: Reminder: add unit test for drop placeholder calc and add an accessibility checklist item for route reordering. :white_check_mark:
maria: Thanks team — small follow-up: change the copy to the final wording: `No active routing rules match this input yet. Try relaxing filters or add a new rule.` Can we land that with the copy PR?
charlie: Fine by me. I'll update the design spec and include the dashed placeholder mock.
maria: Great — tagging this for sprint planning. :rocket:
